toolErrors.cronDetail: The scheduled task could not be created, updated, or run. Check its configuration and the gateway connection, then retry.
toolErrors.updateGoalDetail: The task goal status could not be updated, but completed operations were not undone. Check the result and rerun the task if needed.
toolErrors.nodesDetail: The device node could not complete the request. Confirm it is online, paired, and has the required permissions, then retry.
toolErrors.messageDetail: The message could not be delivered. Check the recipient, channel, and attachments, then retry.
toolErrors.skillWorkshopDetail: The skill could not be generated or validated. Check the skill content and files, then retry.
toolErrors.canvasDetail: The canvas could not be generated or updated. Simplify the content and retry, or use plain text if it continues.
toolErrors.browserDetail: The browser could not complete the operation. Check that the page is accessible, then refresh or reopen it and retry.
toolErrors.commandDetail: The command did not complete. Check the required files and runtime, confirm that no partial result was produced, then retry.
toolErrors.responseDetail: No valid response was generated. Retry once; if it continues, switch models or start a new chat.

sidebar.sessionSwitchBlockedWhilePreparing: The agent is preparing its first reply. Please wait before switching threads or starting a new chat.

errors.modelResponseTimeout: No assistant reply was received for a while, so this request was stopped. Check your network, AI provider settings, or try again later.
errors.modelResponseTimeoutLong: No assistant reply was received after a long wait, so this request was stopped. The model may still be queued or warming up, the provider may be unavailable or rate-limited, or the AI provider settings may be incorrect. Check Settings → AI Providers or switch models, then try again.
errors.llmIdleTimeout: The model stopped returning output, so this run ended automatically. Try again later, or start a new chat if it keeps happening.
errors.llmRequestTimeout: The model request timed out before a reply was generated. Retry later; if it continues, check the network or switch models.
errors.isolatedAgentSetupTimeout: The agent timed out while preparing context, so the task did not start. Retry manually; if it continues, restart the app and try again.
errors.providerPayloadRejected: The model provider rejected the current request or tool parameter format, so execution did not start. Switch models and retry, or start a new chat if it continues.
errors.agentCouldNotGenerateResponse: The agent could not generate a response. Some tool actions may already have run; verify the result before retrying manually.
errors.gatewayRestartInterrupted: The Gateway restarted and interrupted this run before it finished. Wait for the Gateway to reconnect, then retry manually.
errors.outboundDeliveryBadRequest: The messaging service rejected this delivery request. Check the recipient, message content, or attachments, then retry.
errors.commandExecutionFailed: The command did not complete. Check the required files and runtime, confirm that no partial result was produced, then retry.
errors.runEndedWithoutResult: This run has ended. If you did not receive a complete result, retry manually.
errors.rpcTimeout: Communication with the service timed out and the current flow did not continue. Try again later.
errors.toolCallStreamInvalid: The model returned an invalid tool-call format, so this run did not finish. Try again once, or start a new chat if it keeps happening.
errors.outboundMediaFailed: Confirm the image or attachment is still available, then upload it again and retry.
errors.emptyFinalStale: This session is stale. Recover it first, then retry your message manually.
errors.emptyFinalWaiting: The session state is still being confirmed. Wait a moment; if it does not recover, stop the run or start a new chat.
errors.emptyFinalRecovered: The session was recovered. Retry your last message manually.
errors.emptyFinalFailed: The session could not be recovered. Stop the current run or start a new chat, then retry.
errors.backendRunStopped: The backend agent stopped responding (model call timeout or service interruption). This task did not finish. Try again later or narrow the task scope.
errors.runAbortedBySystem: The run was interrupted before it finished. Please try again.
errors.toolExecutionTimeout: A tool call stopped responding for too long, so this run was stopped. Check whether the command is stuck, or retry with a smaller task.
errors.contextTooLarge: This conversation is too large. Automatic compression still exceeds the current model limit. Use stronger compression, switch to a larger-context model, or start a new chat.
errors.currentMessageTooLarge: This message is too long for the current model's safe context budget. Split the input or provide the content as a file/attachment.
errors.contextCompressionFailedRecentOnly: Context compression failed. Only recent conversation turns were kept for this request; earlier history was not included.
errors.subagentStalled: Sub-task "{{label}}" stopped making progress (it may be stuck in a model call). The main task is not finished. Stop the run or narrow the sub-task and try again.
